title: Revisiting $q$-Derangement Numbers via Decorated Permutations
summary: This paper aims to provide a direct combinatorial proof of the Gessel-Wachs formula for $q$-derangement numbers in the setting of decorated permutations, without using the $q$-binomial inversion formula. Decorated permutations, introduced by Postnikov in his study of the totally nonnegative Grassmannian, provide a natural framework for Chen's signed fixed-point model.
